title: 第18章 现阶段谁能屠龙？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    许默迅速回消息。

    【许默：四份狼肉，爱换不换。你要是有能力用这图纸，现在就不会在这里跟我讨价还价。三秒钟，不换我找别人。】

    另一边。

    刘忠涵躲在地下洞穴，冻得满脸鼻涕。

    看着屏幕上的回复，狠狠往地上啐了一口。

    他抓着一块烤得半生不熟的树根拼命撕咬，嘴里骂骂咧咧，手指却诚实地按下了【同意交易】。

    “妈的，能弄死狼的狠人，绝对是个顶尖大佬。现在吃点亏，以后得多抱抱大腿……”

    白光闪过。

    许默手中多了一张图纸。他走到简易工作台前，手掌按上台面，果断扣除5单位木材。

    【叮！】

    伴随着机械的组装声，一个结实耐用的初级鸟笼赫然出现在石屋中央。

    【鸟笼：家具（渡鸦）】

    【等阶：一阶】

    【耐久：20/20】

    【饱食：3/10】

    【特性一：驯化。可“驯化”禽类，同一人持续喂养4次完成绝对服从，每日饱食度上限可填满两次。】

    【特性二：放飞。归巢后可传递周遭视野情报，每日2次，成功率50%。】

    信息传递！

    简直就是神器！

    而且每天喂两次，两天就能直接驯化，省去了太多流程，性价比太高了！

    壁炉边，方芸用木棍挑起滋滋冒油的烤肉。

    她一眼就瞥见了木笼，以及里面那只已经停止扑腾、正用红眼珠看着许默的变异黑鸟。

    成了！

    方芸连肉都顾不上吃，快步凑上前。

    “你赶紧趁热打铁再搓一个出来！直接挂到交易行去，那些人绝对愿意倾家荡产来换！”

    许默眼皮微抬，将手中那条带着盐粒的烤肉塞进嘴里。

    “急什么。”

    “现在挂上去，只能换来一堆破烂。等完全天黑。”

    方芸一怔，随即恍然。

    白天所有人都在外拼命搜寻物资，根本没空盯着交易面板。

    只有等夜幕降临，那些侥幸活下来的玩家缩回庇护所瑟瑟发抖时，才是他们手里筹码最多、也最容易被恐惧支配的时候。

    火光摇曳，将两人的影子在粗糙的石壁上拉得老长。

    吃饱喝足，许默靠在壁炉边，借着温暖的火光调出交易面板。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xu Mo quickly responded to the message.

【Xu Mo: Four portions of wolf meat, you can exchange it if you like.If you had the ability to use this blueprint, you wouldn't be bargaining with me here now.Three seconds, if you don’t change, I’ll find someone else.】

The other side.

Liu Zhonghan was hiding in an underground cave, his face covered with snot from the cold.

Looking at the reply on the screen, I spat hard on the ground.

He grabbed a piece of half-cooked tree root and bit it hard, cursing in his mouth, but honestly pressed [agree to transaction] with his finger.

"Damn, a ruthless person who can kill a wolf is definitely a top boss. If you suffer a little loss now, you will have to hug your thighs more in the future..."

A white light flashed.

Xu Mo had an extra drawing in his hand.He walked to the simple workbench, pressed his palms on the tabletop, and decisively deducted 5 units of wood.

【Ding!】

Accompanied by the sound of mechanical assembly, a sturdy and durable primary birdcage suddenly appeared in the center of the stone house.

【Birdcage: Furniture (Raven)】

【Level: First Level】

【Durability: 20/20】

【Satiated: 3/10】

【Characteristic 1: Domestication.Poultry can be "tamed" and fed 4 times by the same person to achieve absolute obedience, and the daily satiety limit can be filled twice.】

【Characteristic 2: Flying.After returning home, it can transmit surrounding vision information twice a day, with a success rate of 50%.】

Information transfer!

It’s simply an artifact!

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​: It can be directly tamed in two days, which saves too many processes and is very cost-effective!

By the fireplace, Fang Yun used a wooden stick to stir up the sizzling and oily barbecue.

She caught a glimpse of the wooden cage and the mutated black bird inside that had stopped flapping and was looking at Xu Mo with its red eyes.

It’s done!

Fang Yun didn't even bother to eat the meat, and quickly stepped forward.

"Hurry up and strike while the iron is hot and get another one! Just hang it up with the trading house. Those people will definitely be willing to lose all their money to exchange it!"

Xu Mo raised his eyelids slightly and stuffed the salty barbecue in his hand into his mouth.

"What's the rush?"

"If you hang it up now, you will only get a pile of rags. Wait until it gets completely dark."

Fang Yun was startled, then suddenly realized.

During the day, everyone was busy searching for supplies outside and had no time to stare at the transaction panel.

Only when night falls and those players who are lucky enough to survive retreat to their shelters and shiver, is when they have the most chips and are most easily dominated by fear.

The swaying light of the fire stretched the shadows of the two people on the rough stone wall.

After eating and drinking, Xu Mo leaned against the fireplace and used the warm firelight to bring up the trading panel.
